dataset_description: Dealer-level ABC segmentation based on year-to-date sales. All dealers are ranked globally by YTD sales and split into three equal tiers: A (top third), B (middle third), C (bottom third). Segmentation is not partitioned by country.

reporting_period_logic.ytd_window: Current year, all months where sales_actual_YTD is not null

quantile.description: NTILE(3) rank by ytd_sales_eur globally. 1 = top third, 2 = middle third, 3 = bottom third.

segment.description: ABC label derived from quantile. A = quantile 1 (top), B = quantile 2 (middle), C = quantile 3 (bottom).

A.condition: Top third of all dealers by YTD sales — global ranking, not per country.

B.condition: Middle third of all dealers by YTD sales — global ranking.

C.condition: Bottom third of all dealers by YTD sales — global ranking.

segment_c.meaning: Dealer is in the bottom third globally by YTD sales.

segment_a.meaning: Dealer is a top-third performer globally by YTD sales.

recommended_insights: YTD sales value supporting the segment
Segment as context for visit urgency and engagement level

talking_point_generation.segment_a: Dealer is a Segment A top performer by YTD sales — a strategic account to protect and grow.
talking_point_generation.segment_b: Dealer is Segment B with potential to move into Segment A through targeted engagement.
talking_point_generation.segment_c: Dealer is Segment C — bottom third globally — and may require focused intervention.

llm_instructions: Use segment (A, B, or C) as the primary positioning indicator for the dealer.
Reference ytd_sales_eur to support the segment label.
Segmentation is global, not per-country — do not describe it as a country-level comparison.
Segment A = top third, B = middle third, C = bottom third by YTD sales across all dealers.
Do not invent reasons for the segment placement.
Use segment to frame overall visit urgency and engagement approach — Segment C requires more urgency than Segment A.
Support every statement with actual metric values.
Generate concise business-focused insights suitable for a sales representative preparing for a dealer discussion.
